item.title: City of Amarillo announces new public parking option available at Rick Husband Amarillo International Airport
item.description: The City of Amarillo announced that travelers at Rick Husband Amarillo International Airport now have another option for parking their vehicles.

item.title: Man accused of sending fake ‘biological agent’ to Amarillo Federal Court found competent to stand trial
item.description: A man accused of allegedly mailing threatening letters to federal judges in Texas and New York, as well as sending a fake stand-in for a biological toxin to multiple courthouses, was found competent to stand trial after an examination requested in July 2025.

item.title: Man arrested by Amarillo Police Department on Federal drug charges
item.description: One man has been arrested and charged for alleged “Possession with Intent to Distribute 500 grams or more of Methamphetamine,” according to documents filed on Monday in the United States District Court for the Northern District of Texas.

item.title: Amarillo Better Business Bureau announces 2026 Torch Awards finalists
item.description: The 2026 Torch Awards for Ethics competition finalists have been announced by the Better Business Bureau of Amarillo.

item.title: Man indicted for alleged April 2025 pharmacy robbery
item.description: One man has been indicted in the United States District Court for the Northern District of Texas for alleged robbery of controlled substances from a pharmacy.

item.title: Two men arrested on alleged methamphetamine, illegal weapons charges
item.description: Two men were arrested on Wednesday on charges allegedly connected to drug possession and illegal gun possession, according to court documents filed in the United States District Court for the Northern District of Texas.

item.title: Man convicted of murder pleads guilty to 3 motions to revoke probation
item.description: A man convicted of murder in Potter County was back before a judge in Randall County.

item.title: Governor Abbott, HHSC announce SNAP replacement benefits extension following winter storm
item.description: On Monday, Governor Greg Abbott announced that the Texas Health and Human Services Commission received approval to extend the time Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program recipients can apply for replacement benefits for food lost or destroyed due to winter storms.

item.title: Gov. Abbott cites youth alcohol arrests to criticize statewide public school ICE protests
item.description: Governor Greg Abbott expressed his displeasure with the school walkouts protesting ICE, while Hays CISD implemented rules to prevent further walkouts and the Texas Education Agency issued a directive on how to handle future walkouts.

item.title: Midweek cooldown; end of the week warmup
